static_traits.name: Chen Ming
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends but unwilling to talk about Self-doubt; relationship with sister affected; most clients satisfied with repeat customers
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy; no similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, highly cooperative; able to self-observe thought patterns; often using absolutist and labeling expressions (e.g. 'never good enough'); tending to negate positive feedback and achievements; Work situations accompanied by Anxiety and self-criticism

basic_info.main_problem: Because my sister was not satisfied with the makeup I did for her, I began to have strong Self-doubt and inadequacy about my Makeup artist skills, generalizing one piece of negative feedback to my overall ability, affecting my confidence and performance at Work.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling support and guidance to challenge and restructure negative beliefs, ease Self-doubt, and recover professional confidence as a Makeup artist.

core_beliefs: I am a terrible Makeup artist/Artist

special_situations.event: Sister expressed dissatisfaction with the makeup I did for her, pointing out the makeup was not even and not what she Anticipated
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If important family members do not like my work, it proves my overall ability is insufficient and I am a bad Artist
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves herself and avoids making mistakes again by doubling practice and watching online tutorials
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a terrible makeup artist

special_situations.event: Each time starting to do makeup for a new client
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If clients are not completely satisfied, it means I failed; I must satisfy every client
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: High Self-monitoring at Work, pursuing perfection to avoid dissatisfaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not be satisfied; I might mess up

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback from clients or seeing repeat customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' praise does not reflect real ability; it may just be politeness, not enough to show I really have the skill
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating successful experiences, continuing extra practice to make up for the supposed inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite; I am just lucky

special_situations.event: Repeatedly Recalling sister's negative evaluations and consequently Relationship tension
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I disappoint my family, it means I am useless and this is my fault
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing unease with friends, Reduced socializing to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed her; it is all my fault

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed by significant others (family and clients)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, Being rejected and failure, worrying about disappointing loved ones
defense_goal: Avoiding hurt and being negated again through Self-monitoring and negating positive evidence
Staying cautious and self-critical to gain a sense of control, reducing uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: A disappointing, not-good-enough brother and professional

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive evidence or encourages accepting positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others' praise is not genuine, just politeness; experiencing others as ignoring facts or being overly optimistic
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a questioning and reserved tone, emphasizing 'they are just being polite', downplaying positive evidence, and avoiding emotional involvement.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When starting work for a new client and facing possible evaluation and feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing partial dissatisfaction as total failure, believing anything less than perfect is completely no good (all good or all bad)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolutist statements (e.g. 'either perfect or failure'), tense tone, tending toward Self-deprecation and increased Self-monitoring.

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss Self-doubt and unease with friends
One piece of negative feedback in an intimate relationship is given great significance, repeatedly and intrusively recalled
At work, often feels the pressure of bearing others' evaluations alone

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-Reflection and excessive self-limitation, harshness, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Excessive worry and self-scrutiny when starting with new clients
Focusing attention on mistakes and inadequacy
Pursuing perfection at Work to avoid dissatisfaction

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others
manifestations: Presupposing others will be dissatisfied, attributing unease to others' attitudes

contact_model.definition: Turning energy originally directed outward toward oneself, restraining making demands or expressing to others
manifestations: Not discussing unease and Self-doubt with friends, choosing to bear it alone

positive_force: Objective evidence that most clients are satisfied with the works and there are returning clients
Actively practicing and watching online tutorials to improve skills
Willing to seek professional counseling; positive attitude
Holding professional certification and work experience in makeup artistry
negative_force: Overgeneralization and Catastrophizing leading to overall Self-denial
The habit of negating positive feedback making success hard to internalize
Negative predictions about the future and mind-reading aggravating Work Anxiety
Self-worth strongly dependent on external evaluation (seeking external validation)
High Self-monitoring and Perfectionism tendency when starting Work

target_behavior.behavior: Experiencing Significant anxiety and Self-denial when starting to do makeup for new clients, Anticipating clients will be dissatisfied
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one piece of negative feedback from a close person as overall inadequacy, and letting external evaluation determine self-worth (seeking external validation)
target_behavior.function: Escaping the possibility of being negated through advance worry and high Self-monitoring, seeking control to reduce uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Work efficiency and Decreased confidence, Increased stress, tense client interactions, Daily life affected

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive feedback (believing others are just being polite or one was just lucky), struggling to internalize successful experiences
antecedent: When repeat customers or positive reviews appear
target_behavior.core_reason: Maintains a negative self-schema to avoid being disappointed again after expectations rise
target_behavior.function: Lowering expectations to ease Anxiety and avoid emotional setbacks
target_behavior.consequence: Self-efficacy hard to improve, Persistent self-doubt and damaged occupational confidence
